correctness.rationale: The variance ODE vdot=-(2k+r)v+2T implies a contracting two-stage affine map. Solving yields the displayed exact mechanical quench-work formula. Its normalized expression g(r)H_tau(r), with g=alpha/2-K/[2(2r+a+b)] and H<1 via z coth z>1, has uniform small-r tau expansion H=1-(r+a)(r+b)tau²/12+O((r tau)^4). Benchmark r=c tau^-2/3 yields loss K/(4c)+alpha c²/24; a global optimizer must have r→∞ and r tau→0 and is trapped at c tau^-2/3 with c bounded away from zero/infinity. The strictly convex loss has c³=3K/alpha. Independent moment-equation evaluation agrees with exact formula to 10^-17, and optimized-rate ratios for tau=.04,.01,.002 approach 1.
